one_line: Hold each product up in turn with a one-line label, then end on a save-for-the-occasion ask.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a hand holds up the Monopoly "פלאי עולם" box before a white outdoor sofa and a lattice wall. No speech. Text builds from "קבלו 5 משחקים שבני 10" to "...ומעלה ייהנו מהם:" by 0:01.
q1_hook.why: A number and an age in the first card promise a short list for a named audience (H1, T3, H2), with the first box already in hand (S1). There is no voice or face (H4, H6), and the thin text over a busy lattice wall is easy to miss (T5).

beats.what: Hand holds up the Monopoly box; "קבלו 5 משחקים שבני 10 ומעלה ייהנו מהם:"
beats.why: List promise with the first item

beats.what: The Risk box is held up; "סיכון - משחק כיבושים מלהיב"
beats.why: Item two, same move, new label
Item three, very bright box art

beats.what: A Taboo box is held over the stack; a fifth box slides in from the right; "טאבו"
beats.why: Items four and five in one beat

beats.what: High angle on a Monopoly game in progress on a tile floor; "ומונופול כי מונופול!"
The Monopoly box is pushed into the foreground; "שמרו לכן את הפוסט לקראת היומולדת הקרוב"
beats.why: A reason to save, held 3 s

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen 0:08 to 0:11: save the post for the upcoming birthday. Caption: "תשמרו לכן רשימה", and a question, "מי שיחק צוללות על דף משבצות כשהיה קטן?".
q2_flow.why: Five boxes arrive about every 1 to 2 s with the same move, so the list is easy to follow (R3, E2), and 11 s leaves no sag (R1, R2). The fifth game is cut off by the frame, and each label stays about 1 s, too short to save a list from (R7).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:08 to 0:11: "שמרו לכן את הפוסט לקראת היומולדת הקרוב". Caption first line: "תשמרו לכן רשימה של משחקים..."; the same idea, a weekly family game. Caption's last line: "בשיתוף עם קודקוד". No link or price.
q3_cta.why: One save ask with a reason, a coming birthday, placed after the list (C1, C2, C6), clear of the bottom band (T4). It is a save, not a send, so it names no person to send to (C4). Nothing is said aloud.

q4_shown.what: Four boxes held up one at a time (Monopoly "פלאי עולם", Risk, "טיסה 501", Taboo) and a fifth partly seen; one Monopoly game in play from above, only legs and hands visible; the Monopoly box in the foreground. No price, no face.
q4_shown.why: Boxes are in hand from 0:00 with large readable art (S1, F4), hands only (S4, F5), and one real game in progress. The other four games are shown only as boxes. No face is visible (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 5 shots in 11 s (first pass), about 2.2 s each, hard cuts or hand swaps on one fixed frame. No speed change seen. Text changes every 1 to 3 s. Ends on a held box for 3 s with the save ask.
q5_edit.why: Quick swaps on one steady frame keep it fast and easy to follow (E2, E1). With no voice, small thin text carries everything (E4, T1, T2). A clean ending on the ask, with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A five-game round-up for ages 10 and up, with a save-for-the-birthday idea; it serves parents of older children looking for family game ideas.
q6_topic.why: It names a buying moment, a coming birthday (K7), and a real concern, family time with older kids (K6). A list of gift ideas is something to forward to someone (R5), and to save (R7, weak). The mood is light, with no emotional peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone fixed at eye level on a sunny patio, white outdoor sofa and lattice wall behind; a woman's hand lifts each box from below the frame. Last shot: handheld, high angle on a Monopoly board on tiles, then the box pushed into the foreground.
q7_filmed.why: A fixed frame and plain background keep the boxes large and readable (F4, F7), in daylight (E6). The hold-up move is a clean hands-only format (S4). The last shot is a tilted handheld view (F5), but it shows a real game.

q8_text.on_screen: Small thin white Hebrew, centred, about 27 to 40% down, over the lattice wall or the boxes: 0:00 "קבלו 5 משחקים שבני 10", 0:02 "סיכון - משחק כיבושים מלהיב", 0:04 "טאבו", 0:05 "אי" (cut off), 0:07 "ומונופול כי מונופול!", 0:08 "שמרו לכן את הפוסט לקראת היומולדת הקרוב".
q8_text.caption: "תשמרו לכן רשימה של משחקים שמתאימים לילדים גדולים, בני נוער ולמבוגרים,". About 164 words: a weekly family game idea, one line per game, a personal memory, a list of more titles, "בשיתוף עם קודקוד" last. No hashtags.
q8_text.why: Text sits inside the safe zone, and the first card states topic and age (T3, T4). But it is thin and small, white on a busy wall, labels held about 1 s (T5, T2). The caption lists each game in searchable words and asks one specific question (T7, C5), the partnership named last (T8, S7).

weak_points: Labels on screen about 1 s each; the fifth game cut off; thin small text over a busy wall; only one game shown in play; no voice; the Kodkod collaboration named only on the caption's last line.
lumebook_takeaway: Hold up each LumeBook book in turn on a plain background, a one-line label each; end on a spread and a save-for-the-birthday line.
not_verified: The fifth game's title (the caption lists "אי הויקינגים"; the frame shows only a partial label "אי"); whether the family on the floor is the creator's; music (not established); who the hand belongs to; cut times from the first pass. Text contrast judged by eye.
